hook.say: True or false? Five ocean facts, three seconds each. The last one is hiding deep underwater!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Water covers about 71% of Earth's surface.
questions.say: Water covers about 71 percent of Earth's surface.
questions.fact: About 71% of our planet's surface is covered by water.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Roughly 71 percent of our planet's surface is covered by water.

questions.q: The Atlantic is the deepest ocean.
questions.fact: The Pacific is. Its Mariana Trench plunges almost 11 km down.
questions.sayAnswer: False! The Pacific is. Its Mariana Trench plunges almost 11 kilometers down.

questions.q: The Pacific Ocean is bigger than all of Earth's land combined.
questions.fact: The Pacific covers 165 million km². All land adds up to about 149 million.
questions.sayAnswer: True! The Pacific is so vast that every continent could fit inside it.

questions.q: Point Nemo, the ocean's most remote spot, is in the Atlantic.
questions.fact: It is in the South Pacific, about 2,688 km from the nearest land.
questions.sayAnswer: False! It is in the South Pacific, almost 2700 kilometers from the nearest land.

questions.q: The world's largest waterfall is underwater.
questions.fact: The Denmark Strait cataract drops about 3.5 km beneath the sea surface.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Between Iceland and Greenland, cold water plunges about 3 and a half kilometers down.
